title: Custom Patriotic Trucking Semi Truck Below Waving American Flag Comforter
description:
Rev up your bedroom decor with the Custom Semi Truck Bedding Comforter from Jeminise. Perfect for truckers and semi-truck enthusiasts, this soft and cozy comforter set brings patriotic trucking style to your space, customized with your own name input for a personal touch.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features a custom name input field to personalize your trucking bedding.
  • Patriotic Trucking Theme: Features a semi truck design positioned below a waving American flag over a sunset highway background.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Included Components: Package options include 1 duvet cover or filled comforter with optional matching pillowcases.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, quick-drying, and lightweight for all-season comfort.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Color Red Trucker Art
Style Modern
Theme Patriotic trucking
Pattern Cartoon
Seasons All
Customization 1 text input
Care Instructions Machine Wash
